donor_rule: For each same-sentence four-question receiver packet, use the opposite voice with the same names, verb, direction, event/question labels, or a role-reversed opposite-voice donor. Align source name-token sites by name.
intervention: At a single block's pre-attention normalized Q/K/V projections, replace only K/V at second-event participant NAME tokens, only Q at answer position, or both. No other Q/K/V or residual changes at the injection site. Later blocks are computed normally.
norm_controls: Reversed donor and deterministic random displacement directions are matched to the aligned donor change norm per sample/site/head, separately for K, V and Q. When reverse-donor displacement is exactly zero at a site/head, use a seeded random fallback direction and report fallback prevalence. Never zero the residual stream.
output_comparator: Question-type-by-vocabulary additive logit bias, fitted with cross-entropy plus L2 on 24 separate calibration sentences/voice/model. No test labels used in fitting; 120 Adam steps lr=0.1 L2=0.05.
native_and_safety_controls: MHA exact-forward parity; identity donor no-op; same-clause first-event K/V control no-op; nontrivial projected perturbations; norm matching; four question types; four-choice and full-vocab results.
primary_descriptive_scope: Second-event passive questions, all 8 familiar/target paired seeds; report exact wrong-event and wrong-role to correct, harm, donor-vs-control mean gold-margin effects; preserve first-event accuracy.
candidate_rule_exploratory_not_confirmat: For each of source-only, Q-only and joint at either L2/L3 in target/passive, aligned second-event accuracy must exceed reversed, matched-random and output-bias controls (and for joint, each aligned single-site) by >=0.05 mean; advantage positive in >=6/8 seeds and seed-bootstrap 95pct lower >0; aligned wrong-to-correct rate >=0.05; native-correct first-event harm <=0.02. Even if a candidate passes, its result is exploratory and donor answer import remains possible.
stopping_rule: Inspect exactly 2 layers x 3 mechanism families; do not sweep additional sites, donors, doses, examples or seeds after seeing results. If no clean candidate, stop mechanistic search for this paper.
limitations: Reused ML-088 cohort and previously examined ML-092 calibration family; cross-voice donors differ in length/position; Q donor can import answer information; null result doesn't exclude information elsewhere. No claim of native necessity or independent confirmation.
protected: NEVER READ/GENERATE ML-088 OR ML-099 PROTECTED EXAMPLES
